# Dopakit - Printable Planner

This is the printable PDF version of the Dopakit system. Print double-sided or use digitally with a PDF annotator.

---

_________________________________

_________________________________

_________________________________

□ Task: _________________________

_________________________________
_________________________________

## Page 3-4: Task Breakdown Worksheets

Five copies of this template. Use one per complex task.

```
══════════════════════════════
BREAK IT DOWN
══════════════════════════════

The big task: _________________________

Now break it into the smallest possible steps.
Each step should take 5-20 minutes. If a step feels
too big, break it further.

Step 1: _________________________  □
Step 2: _________________________  □
Step 3: _________________________  □
Step 4: _________________________  □
Step 5: _________________________  □
Step 6: _________________________  □
Step 7: _________________________  □
Step 8: _________________________  □

Estimated total time: ____ minutes

Which step do you do first?
The one that takes the least energy.
Circle it. Do that one first. Build momentum.

When done: check off each step.
Your brain needs to SEE the progress.
```

---

## Page 5: Brain Dump

Use when overwhelmed. Get everything out of your head.

```
══════════════════════════════
BRAIN DUMP
══════════════════════════════

Write everything that's swirling around.
Tasks, worries, ideas, obligations.
Don't organize. Don't filter. Just dump.

_________________________________
_________________________________
_________________________________
_________________________________
_________________________________
_________________________________
_________________________________
_________________________________
_________________________________
_________________________________
_________________________________
_________________________________

Now go back. Circle the 3 things that
actually matter this week.
Cross out everything that can wait.

Pick ONE circled item.
What's the smallest step?
Do that now.
```

## Page 7: Dopamine Menu Reference

Print and keep visible. Don't scroll past it.

```
══════════════════════════════
DOPAMINE MENU
══════════════════════════════

Earn rewards by finishing tasks.
Never pre-reward. No phone scrolling.

5-MINUTE REWARDS (after 2 micro-tasks)
  □ Stand up and stretch
  □ Make tea or coffee
  □ Step outside for 60 seconds
  □ One song, loud
  □ 20 jumping jacks
  □ Wash face with cold water
  □ Send a voice note to a friend

15-MINUTE REWARDS (after a focus sprint)
  □ One YouTube video
  □ Read one saved article
  □ Quick walk around the block
  □ Call someone for a chat

30-MINUTE REWARDS (after a project milestone)
  □ One episode of a show
  □ Order favorite lunch
  □ Take a nap
  □ Read a chapter of a book

RULE: If you can't get back to work after a reward,
the reward was too big. Go smaller next time.
```

---

End of printable planner. Print pages 1-7. Use the weekly overview every Sunday. Use daily focus sheets as needed. Keep the dopamine menu visible.
